# Copilot System Prompts

This directory contains system prompts used by GitHub Copilot for this project.

## Structure
- `global-prompts.md`: Contains global settings and guidelines for the entire project
- `english-tutor-prompts.md`: Specific prompts for the English Conversation Tutor feature

## Usage
1. These prompts are automatically loaded by GitHub Copilot when working in this project
2. They provide context and guidelines for AI assistance
3. Update these files to modify AI behavior project-wide

## Best Practices
- Keep prompts clear and specific
- Update prompts when project requirements change
- Document any major changes to prompts
- Test prompt changes with actual usage scenarios

## Note
The effectiveness of these prompts may vary depending on the Copilot version and context.
